data.name: Black Asp's Path
data.description: A black asp is trained in the use of poison and cannot accidentally poison himself when applying poison to a weapon or when rolling a natural 1 on an attack roll with a poisoned weapon.

raw_tokens.value: A black asp is trained in the use of poison and cannot accidentally poison himself when applying poison to a weapon or when rolling a natural 1 on an attack roll with a poisoned weapon.
The black asp's ability to use poison improves. He gains Adder Strike as a bonus feat even if he does not meet the prerequisites.|PRECLASS:1,Monk=3
